cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix your kettle for a spoonful of yesterday. Put the payment in a saucer, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I give you the five minutes I've wasted waiting today?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not at today's rate. Leave them overnight; by morning they'll be yesterday and I can value them properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need tea now. Could you lend me a kettle until then?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For tomorrow's first regret. Don't send me tonight's; that's the mistake we've just corrected.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 added favor for a new symbolic fee and carries forward the date correction.
